construction: The actual normalized optical root factor from N01OpticalRootDivision is used on the full closed component.
The actual raw optical min-distance inequality is cancelled on the positive inward half interval before a one-sided limit with an explicit NeBot instance.
The same actual first-jet envelope determines a displayed harmonic radius shared by both endpoint orientations.
N01 reference optical collars give the inverse half-component width; genuine host/sample comparisons preserve the material cell.
A fixed global scaled E0 lower bound lifts the three powers to a normalized weight; its fixed scaling is absorbed back into the coefficient. The unscaled E0>=1 is never assumed.
The public theorem derives the raw optical certificate from the same retained R11a witness and keeps the same D/T/Sp/C and existing N01 certificate.
limitations: No Lean compilation or CI query.
Does not prove an arbitrary-state common germ or transport jets.
Does not transport Through03 to a new reference, material data or nonlinear geometry.
Requires the actual retained witness certificate to be present for the same reference; this upstream witness-retention issue remains explicit.
scope: Scratch source and metadata only; no checkout/index/ref/authority/plan changes.
